p: Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An EZ curl bar, a short 1.2 m chrome bar with a zig-zag W-shaped centre section offering angled grips, with short plain sleeves at each end loaded with a small plate on each side and spring collars.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A swiss / football bar, a barbell built as a long open ladder frame, with several pairs of neutral grip handles running crossways between two parallel rails, some angled, and standard loading sleeves at each end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of fixed-weight barbells, a row of short barbells with plates permanently welded at each end, each one with a numbered weight on the end cap, resting horizontally on a tiered upright rack.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of thick grips, a pair of thick rubber tubular sleeves with a slit along their length, made to clip around a bar or dumbbell handle to widen it.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A functional training rig, a long run of connected steel uprights and crossbeams forming several squat bays, with multiple pull-up bars at different heights, monkey bar rungs across the top, J-hooks on the uprights and hanging gymnastic rings.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A 3D Smith machine, a large Smith machine whose barbell rides on a carriage that slides both up and down and forwards and backwards on horizontal rails across the top of the frame, allowing movement in two planes.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A bench press station, a flat padded bench joined to a pair of steel uprights at the head end with bar catches at two heights, a barbell resting in the catches and plate storage horns on the uprights.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A seal row bench, a long flat padded bench raised on tall legs to about waist height, with a step and a pair of bar catches underneath so the user can lie face down and row a barbell or dumbbells up to the pad.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of spotter / safety arms, a pair of long steel safety arms with a rubber-lined top surface pinned to the uprights of a rack, alongside a pair of J-shaped bar hooks.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of adjustable dumbbells, a pair of adjustable dumbbells sitting in their moulded cradles, each with a handle inside a stack of nested weight plates and a selector dial or pin to choose the load.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of clubbells / Indian clubs, a pair of bowling-pin-shaped steel or wooden clubs, narrow at the knurled handle and widening to a heavy rounded end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A low pulley, a cable station with a pulley fixed just above floor level at the base of a weight stack tower, with the cable running out horizontally to a handle on the floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A lat pulldown, an upright frame with a seat and padded thigh roller pads in front of a weight stack, a high pulley above the seat holding a long wide bar with angled ends.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An EZ cable bar, a short chrome bar about 50 cm long with a zig-zag W-shaped bend, knurled grips and a central swivel clip ring for connecting to a cable.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A MAG grip / multi-grip handles, a set of row and pulldown handles with a cast aluminium frame in a long U shape, with parallel neutral or pronated grips set at different widths and a clip ring in the centre.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An ab crunch machine, a pin-loaded machine with a seat, padded foot rollers and padded handles or chest pads on an arm above, which curl down towards the knees, and a weight stack at the side.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An ab crunch bench, a short low padded bench with a curved back pad and front foot rollers, used for crunches lying flat.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A curved / self-powered treadmill, a non-motorised treadmill with a concave curved slatted running surface that dips in the middle, and handles at the front.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An Assault / air bike, an upright bike with a large fan wheel at the front, moving handlebars linked to the pedals, a saddle and a small console.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A smart turbo trainer, a compact folding stand that a road bike's rear axle locks into, with the rear wheel removed and the bike chain running on a cassette mounted on a resistance unit with a heavy flywheel.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A lateral trainer, a cardio machine with foot pedals that swing outwards and inwards as well as forwards, and a central upright console.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A Jacob's ladder, an inclined frame with a continuous ladder of horizontal rungs running in a loop at about 40 degrees, with a hip belt on a tether.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A sled pull rope, a long thick braided rope about 15 m long, clipped to the tow ring at the front of a loaded steel sled, coiled loosely on the floor in front of it.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A flywheel trainer, a low square aluminium platform with a flywheel disc mounted inside a frame at one end, a strap running up from the centre of the platform to a padded harness or handle above.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A slam ball, a heavy thick-walled black rubber ball with a ribbed, textured surface and a visible fill valve, slightly squashed where it rests on the floor.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A jump rope, a thin coated steel cable rope with two slim aluminium handles containing bearings, laid out in a loop on the floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A climbing wall / treadwall, a tall panelled wall covered in coloured resin climbing holds, either a fixed bouldering wall with crash mats beneath or a motorised rotating wall panel loop.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of farmer's handles, a pair of long steel bars, each with a central knurled handle raised on a frame and loading horns at each end, sitting parallel on the floor loaded with plates.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A tyre, a huge black tractor tyre about 1.5 m across with deep treads, lying flat on its side on the ground.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A Conan's wheel, a long steel lever arm attached to a central pivot post, with a crook handle at the end that the user carries in the crook of the arms as they walk in a circle, and loading horns near the end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A Hercules hold, two tall upright steel pillars set apart on hinged bases, each with a handle on a short chain, so the user stands between them holding both handles to stop the pillars falling.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A suspension trainer (TRX), a single anchor strap at the top splitting into two adjustable yellow and black nylon webbing straps with rubber handles and foot cradles at the bottom, hanging from a door or bar.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of mini bands / hip circle, a set of short wide loop bands made of woven fabric with rubber grip strips, in three colours of increasing thickness, laid flat.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of parallettes, a pair of low parallel steel or wooden bars about 60 cm long on short splayed legs, set side by side on the floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of sliders, a pair of round flat plastic gliding discs about 18 cm across, with a smooth underside and a soft foam top, resting on a wooden floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A set of hanging ab straps, a pair of padded nylon loops with steel carabiners at the top, clipped to an overhead pull-up bar so the upper arms rest in the loops and the body hangs below.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A foam roller, a firm foam cylinder about 15 cm across and 45 cm long with a textured grid surface over a hollow plastic core, lying on a gym floor.
Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A PVC pipe / dowel, a straight lightweight white PVC pipe or wooden dowel about 1.5 m long and 3 cm thick, lying on a gym floor.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A balance / wobble board, a round flat wooden disc about 40 cm across with a half-sphere pivot underneath it so it tilts in all directions, with a grip surface on top.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: A treatment plinth, a long padded medical treatment couch on a height-adjustable electric steel base, with an adjustable backrest section and a face hole at one end.

Next item, same style as the master, filling about 80% of the frame: An anti-gravity treadmill, a treadmill enclosed in a sealed inflatable fabric chamber at waist height, with a zip-in waist opening, side handles and a front console.
